name: bookmee
description: BookMee 预约+签到系统 - 全栈多行业服务预约平台

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.start:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run start
scripts.start:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run start
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
